name: Error Analysis via Marching Tetrahedra
definition: An error evaluation method based on isosurface extraction using Marching Tetrahedra. It measures the geometric and topological changes in the isosurface when two small tetrahedra are fused into a large one.
summary: Error Analysis via Marching Tetrahedra is a geometric metric that determines if tetrahedra can be fused without exceeding tolerance by evaluating isosurface displacement along segments, ensuring a viewpoint-independent error bound.
